message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout during a game night at my place. As soon as the lights went out, my friend Sarah started panicking, searching for candles like it was a scene from a horror movie! I calmly pulled out my trusty lantern and a power bank to keep our phones charged, turning what could’ve been chaos into a cozy, candle-free evening. Sometimes, just a little prep can turn a potential freak-out into a fun night in! How do you stay calm during a power outage?
